## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-ci`, `area:sdpa`, `mod-frost`.

## Affected area

CI or test infrastructure

## Summary

The native SDPA binding suites (`test_sdpa_native_{dense,prefill,sink,split,arch,ragged_decode}_binding.py`) run their GPU cases through the graph and standalone helpers of `test_sdpa_native_dense_binding.py`. Those helpers take a `cc` argument, default `(10, 0)`, and skip unless the device is exactly that part. So every SM100 case skipped on cc 10.3, although SM103 serves the same sm100 bodies compiled for `sm_103a`.

`_parts(cc)` maps the `(10, 0)` default to the SM100 family, `(10, 0)` and `(10, 3)`. Every other `cc` stays exact: the cc 10.3 and cc 10.7 cases that `test_sdpa_native_arch_binding.py` names keep their part. The skip message names the admitted parts. No product code changes.

## Why

These cases never ran on a B300; this PR runs them there.

## Related issues

#2108 widens the one exact-SM100 standalone split case in `test_sdpa_native_split_binding.py`. This PR does not touch that file, so the two do not overlap.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Test only.

## Testing

B300 (cc 10.3), develop `64ed3dfe` with its own extension, torch 2.14.1+cu130, cuDNN 9.27.0, CuTe DSL 4.8.1, `CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`. From `test/python/sdpa/frost`: `python -m pytest -m "L0 or L1" test_sdpa_native_dense_binding.py test_sdpa_native_prefill_binding.py test_sdpa_native_sink_binding.py test_sdpa_native_split_binding.py test_sdpa_native_arch_binding.py test_sdpa_native_ragged_decode_binding.py`:

| | passed | skipped |
|---|---|---|
| develop | 878 | 225 |
| this PR | 1044 | 59 |

The 59 skips left are 57 cc 10.7 cases and the split case #2108 covers. Not run on cc 10.0, where `_parts` admits the part exactly as before.

files.patch:
@@ -18,6 +18,16 @@
 pytestmark = [pytest.mark.L0]
 
 
+def _parts(cc):
+    """The parts a GPU case declared for ``cc`` runs on. The SM100 cases (the (10, 0) default) run on SM103 too, which serves the same sm100
+    bodies compiled for sm_103a; test_sdpa_native_arch_binding.py names its other cc 10.3 and cc 10.7 cases explicitly."""
+    return ((10, 0), (10, 3)) if cc == (10, 0) else (cc,)
+
+
+def _parts_label(cc):
+    return " or ".join(f"SM{major}{minor}" for major, minor in _parts(cc))
+
+
 def _fixture(dtype="bfloat16", paged=False, hnd=False, lse=True, lengths=True, d=128, sq=1, v_hnd=None, d_v=None):
     d_v = d if d_v is None else d_v
     s = prep.DenseLaunchSpec()
@@ -336,8 +346,8 @@ def test_native_dense_graph_fresh_bindings_and_changed_replay(
 ):
     import torch
 
-    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() != cc:
-        pytest.skip(f"native dense test requires SM{cc[0]}{cc[1]}")
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() not in _parts(cc):
+        pytest.skip(f"native dense test requires {_parts_label(cc)}")
     from frost_test_utils import _dsl_installed
     from test_sdpa_fwd_decode_d128_sm100 import _SM100_ID, _gather_kv, _ref
     from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.engines import SdpaFwdKnobs
@@ -614,8 +624,8 @@ def test_native_dense_unknown_storage_contract_is_preserved():
 def test_native_decode_standalone_rebinds_scale_and_capture(d, sq, monkeypatch, splits=1, stats_mode="ln", d_v=None, prefill=False, has_sink=False, cc=(10, 0)):
     import torch
 
-    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() != cc:
-        pytest.skip(f"native standalone test requires SM{cc[0]}{cc[1]}")
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() not in _parts(cc):
+        pytest.skip(f"native standalone test requires {_parts_label(cc)}")
     from frost_test_utils import _dsl_installed
